_about: Spanish tax and Social Security figures Kronos uses, one block per year. A year without a block uses the latest earlier one (and the page says so). Estimates for planning: verify with an adviser. To add a year, copy the latest block, change what the BOE / Seguridad Social / the region changed, and update the sources.

reta._source: https://www.seg-social.es/wps/portal/wss/internet/HerramientasWeb/9d2fd4f1-ab0f-42a6-8d10-2e74b378ee24 (2026 table, RD-ley 3/2026); rate 28.30 CC + 1.30 CP + 0.90 cese + 0.10 FP + 0.90 MEI
reta._tramos: [upper limit of the monthly net yield (null: no limit), minimum base of that tramo], EUR/month
reta._tarifa_plana: 80 EUR + MEI, first 12 months of a first alta (secondary sources: holded.com, taxdown.es)
reta._pluriactividad: Refund of 50% of the common-contingency contributions (employment + RETA) above this limit, capped at 50% of the RETA common-contingency contributions (Orden PJC/297/2026 art. 18.8, as quoted by autonomosyemprendedor.es)

employee_ss._source: Regimen General 2026, worker share: 4.70 CC + 1.55 desempleo + 0.10 FP + 0.15 MEI; employer + worker common contingencies 23.60 + 4.70; maximum base 5101.20 EUR/month

irpf._source: State scale art. 63 LIRPF (unchanged since 2021); Andalucia art. 23 and 23 bis Ley 5/2021 (Hacienda, Tributacion autonomica 2026, table 3); expenses art. 30 RIRPF; start-up reduction art. 32.3 LIRPF; pago fraccionado art. 110 RIRPF
irpf._deadlines: [month, day] the modelo 130 of each quarter is due (art. 110 RIRPF); the fourth falls in January of the next year
